QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] An Umbrella for Mother
QuestInfo.0: Take the completed bouquet to #bTess#k in #bAltaire Camp#k.
QuestInfo.1:
Tess is worried that Yuris is getting drenched repairing the airship in the rain.
There's a very #bBig Mushroom#k in #bMushroom Hill Entrance#k.
It could be used as an umbrella.
QuestInfo.2:
You got the Big Mushroom and placed it next to Yuris because Tess is worried about his mother getting drenched repairing the airship in the rain.
That should calm his worries a little.

0.msg: Get the #bBig Mushroom#k in #bMushroom Hill Entrance#k and give it to my mother. She's at the #bCamp Entrance#k.
